messages:
Alex Duarte: quick follow-up from today's all-hands  Can leadership publish a short owners + realistic canary windows table for API / Console / Optimize so teams can finalize sprint scope? :wave:

Sasha Lin: short answers up front: API (hosted gen + chat parity) -> target GA 2026-07-12; Console opt-in beta -> 2026-06-28; Optimize (cost hints + batching) -> alpha 2026-08-05. will list owners below. :memo:

Priya Nair: are any of these blocked by Dedicated rollout or by telemetry? need clear dependencies for partner teams.

Sasha Lin: hosted API GA is independent of Dedicated capacity. Optimize alpha depends on telemetry stability (per-request token counts + model-level metrics). Console beta is opt-in, non-breaking.

Marcus Hale: owners (proposed):
- API GA: Sasha Lin (PM) + Marcus Hale (Eng lead)
- Console beta: Alex Duarte (Product) + Priya Nair (DevEx)
- Optimize alpha: Priya Nair (ML infra) + Sasha Lin (Product)
I'll spin up a tiny checklist doc and a 15m weekly sync.

Alex Duarte: please include canary start/end, rollback signals, and SDK compatibility notes. also ask PMs to allocate a marketing liaison for release bullets.

ProductOps-bot: Recording + slides: https://meet.corp/rec/1791234500 (follow-up doc will be attached) :movie_camera:

Marcus Hale: quick canary template suggestion to copy into runbooks:
```
canary:
  ramp: [1, 5, 20]
  step_days: 3
  total_days: 9
  rollback_if:
    - \"5xx_rate > 0.5%\"
    - \"p95_latency > baseline * 1.25\"
    - \"error_rate_delta > 2%\"
```
Use feature flags for Console beta.

Priya Nair: telemetry stabilization ETA is 2026-06-22 (current sprint). if that slips Optimize alpha target moves +2-3 weeks. will post weekly updates here.

Sasha Lin: commitments (targets):
- API: GA target 2026-07-12; canary start 2026-06-28
- Console: opt-in beta 2026-06-28; phased rollout after beta feedback starting 2026-07-20
- Optimize: alpha 2026-08-05 (dependent on telemetry)
These are target dates; we'll run weekly readiness checks.

Alex Duarte: action items I want captured:
- Priya: telemetry status updates weekly until 2026-06-22
- Marcus: finalize API canary plan + health-checks by 2026-06-25
- Sasha: assign marketing liaison and draft release bullets by 2026-06-18
- Priya/Alex: Console beta quickstarts + SDK notes by 2026-06-24
I'll create the calendar invites. :calendar:

Priya Nair: copy of checklist v0: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/checklists/1791234567 (owners can edit). short excerpt included.

Alex Duarte: great, thanks. PS: if any team expects >10 day slip, flag here so we can re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
